Kunming

Stone Forest & Dianchi Lake day trip

Dianchi Lake in the morning, the Stone Forest in the afternoon — the classic Kunming day out.

Request a Call

Itinerary

  • 08:10Assemble at Yongfeng Road and board.
  • 08:30Depart for Dianchi Lake scenic area — 10 km, about 30 minutes. Guide introduces the day and checks the group in.
  • 09:00Dianchi Lake — the largest freshwater lake in Yunnan. From October to March, black-headed gulls arrive from Lake Baikal in Siberia.
  • 11:10Lunch, Ashima-style local cooking, shared table.
  • 12:00Stone Forest scenic area, about two hours: major and minor stone forests, Shilin Lake, the stone screen, the classic viewpoints, the cat rock, the lotus pond and the Ashima formation.
  • 15:00Return to Kunming, Guanshang old street.
  • 16:30Trip ends on site.

Included

Good to know

  • Return traffic in peak season runs late. Ask before booking if you have an onward connection.
  • The coach plate number is texted to you the evening before departure.
  • Bring a valid ID; children need a household register booklet.
